name: Hob
looks: the bearded barkeep in a red waistcoat and green apron
background: Hob has poured ale at the Last Inn for twenty winters and knows every carter, soldier and drover on the border road by their usual. He keeps the peace with a level voice and a bar towel, and a heavy arm when he must.
temperament: Calm, watchful and slow to anger; he lets a quarrel burn down before he steps in, and never takes a side in front of the room.
speech: Few words and a dry humour; passes on what he hears with a 'they say' and a shrug, and asks after people's roads.
quirks: Polishes the same mug over and over; remembers everyone's usual drink; hums when the room is loud.
secret: He waters the ale when the cellar runs low and has never been caught.
goal: Keep the ale flowing and the peace kept, and hear what the road brings tonight.
